title: C-PHAST counterfactual microgrid reconfiguration

models.label: C-PHAST
models.description: Maintained CompositionalPHAST with fixed source-trained component laws.

models.label: N-PHDAE + algebraic correction (extension)
models.description: Explicit solver extension: correct algebraic variables after each author RK4 step, preserving all 14 charge/flux coordinates. Retains declared initialization and composed-training extensions.

models.label: N-PHDAE original RK4 (extended pipeline)
models.description: Original author RK4 stepping, with declared initialization and composed-training extensions. Finite saved trajectories fail algebraic-residual qualification and remain diagnostic.

scope: All 80 physical production roots: five training fits, 16 episodes per fit, two receiving-bus candidates, 160 branch outcomes per model. No filtering, downsampling, new physics, training, or experiments.
C-PHAST does not meet the frozen primary accuracy criterion against corrected N-PHDAE on this study.

C-PHAST has lower voltage, DGU-current and line-current trajectory RMSE in every fit; mean reductions against corrected N-PHDAE are 64.06%, 70.25% and 28.50%. This does not establish a peak-current or decision win.

Numerically qualified branches: C-PHAST 160/160, corrected N-PHDAE 160/160, original N-PHDAE 0/160. Original N-PHDAE has 160 finite complete trajectories with constraint_failed status, retained diagnostically.

Both qualified models rank the receiving-bus candidates correctly on 80/80 resolved physical roots. Original N-PHDAE also orders 80/80 correctly, but has 0/80 qualified pairs. No established decision win. Reference peak-current gaps at most 0.002 mA are unresolved; ordering is not a safety certificate.

Corrected N-PHDAE is an explicit algebraic-correction solver extension, not unmodified N-PHDAE. Both N-PHDAE variants use the declared initialization and composed-training extensions, and share weights, initial raw states and controls.

A four-DGU physical present state is supplied in full. Each candidate retains that storage and adds the same DGU and line at a different receiving bus, with supplied added states and held physical inputs. Fixed component laws; no observer, candidate-specific history, retraining or target fitting.

reference.states exports the saved independent physical-reference array 'reference' used for the report's metrics (project DOP853), not 'reference_refined' (RK45). Both originals remain in the source archives.

Qualification is copied from each record's status == 'valid', following analyzer.py. Residual-check failure is a model numerical-qualification failure, not plant failure. Native and author residuals concern different equations and cannot be compared as an accuracy ratio.

This small-network full-state counterfactual-reconfiguration study does not establish learned-observer accuracy, true-law identification, architecture-only causation, long-horizon stability, calibrated uncertainty, continuous-time peak bounds, universal superiority, or cross-model speed advantage.

SI units: seconds, volts, amperes, ohms, joules. peakCurrent is the maximum absolute line current over future samples 1..200. voltageRmse and currentRmse exclude time zero; currentRmse is line-current RMSE only, not DGU-current RMSE. voltageMin/voltageMax span all buses and all 201 samples. lineLossJ is the trapezoidal integral over times of sum(lineResistance * lineI^2), using supplied physical line resistances; it is not full-system energy or an energy-balance certificate.
